name: web-architecture-site-on-tablet-held-against-mountain-house-photo
title: Architecture Site Tablet Held against Blue Sky
whatItIs: A cover with two hands holding a tablet whose screen shows a mountain house site with a large white headline 'The Infinite Precision of Living' and a black plan card, against a deep blue gradient, with two square logos and a 2026 tag.
whatItMeans: The tablet's dramatic rock photo becomes the cover's colour, and the deep blue frames it calmly.
techniques: Held tablet filling most of the frame
Photo hero with overlaid heading inside the UI
Deep blue backdrop matched to the sky
Logo squares and year tag in the corners
Black spec card with plan drawing

vocabulary.definition: A dark card listing area and type of a property.
A tablet shown in hands at a slight angle.
A small outlined box giving the project year.
